items: Google ranks local results on relevance, distance and prominence, and while you can't change where a searcher is, you can make every listing complete, accurate and well reviewed.
Manage every location's listings from one place so names, addresses, phone numbers, hours and categories match across Google, Apple Maps, Yelp, Facebook and other directories.
Ask for reviews right after a visit with an easy SMS or email link, and reply to every review, because review quantity, quality and freshness affect your Maps ranking.
Give each location its own local photos, landmarks and offers, then track views, calls, direction requests and ratings to find the stores that need attention.
